messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=model-catalog severity=high reason=\"autopromote set incompatible revision\" link=grafana/alerts/54321

incident-bot: PagerDuty key PD-2026-ACAT created. auto-escalation to eng-oncall + eng-runtime.

sara: ack. I'm oncall. seeing a sharp spike in 5xx and a lot of \"TokenDecodeError: unknown_token_map\" in the catalog runtime logs. Customers hitting /v1/models/xyz getting malformed JSON.

oliver: looking at runtime traces — runtime-v3 is throwing when loading KV cache for rev rev-q4-int8. The tokenizer metadata in catalog for that revision is \"encoding:bytepair\" but model family canonical is \"encoding:wordpiece\". decode path bails.

mike: autopromote job ran an hour ago after green validation. I pulled the promote logs:
```
autopromote: candidate=rev-q4-int8 validated=healthchecks only
tokenizer_compat_check=not_present
promote -> rev-q4-int8
```
Looks like tokenizer compatibility check was accidentally gated behind a flag and returned SKIPPED.

jane-support: we have 4 tickets so far. Acme Corp (TCK-100), BetaApps (TCK-101), and two internal QA warnings. All report truncated outputs or JSON parsing failures.

emily-pm: customer impact: some production calls returned invalid JSON, some failed fast. We should assume possible data loss for those requests and offer immediate remediation. Also need a short customer-ready blurb once we confirm scope.

sara: mitigation plan now: 1) pin default back to previous stable rev rev-2025-main 2) suspend autopromote schedule + disable the new autopromote flag 3) blacklist rev-q4-int8 in catalog so it won't be routed 4) sanity-check cache state and purge any prefix caches referencing the bad rev. Executing step 1 now.

mike: command to pin default: `redwoodctl catalog set-default --model xyz --revision rev-2025-main`

oliver: confirmed catalog default pointed back to rev-2025-main. Runtime requests are now hitting rev-2025-main. Error rate dropped sharply in the last minute.

tim: suspending cronjob and flipping feature flag.

mike: cronjob suspended: `kubectl -n infra patch cronjob/autopromote -p '{\"spec\":{\"suspend\":true}}'` and feature flag `autopromote_allow_quantized=true` set to false in flagstore.

sara: blacklisting revision in catalog: `redwoodctl catalog blacklist --model xyz --revision rev-q4-int8 --reason "incompatible tokenizer"` -> applied.

oliver: runtime guard PR in flight: runtime will now reject model revisions where catalog.tokenizer != family.canonical_tokenizer, returning a 409 instead of attempting decode. Will cut prod deployment after review.

mike: root cause short: autopromote validation path did not assert tokenizer compatibility for quantized candidate revisions. A new quantized build slipped through and was auto-promoted.

tim: running catalog scan across all models for tokenizer mismatches. Quick pass shows 2 other models with at least one revision metadata mismatch. Opening follow-up issues.

jane-support: support has logged all impacted orgs and updated each ticket with mitigation steps and ETA for postmortem. Drafting outbound note for impacted customers.

emily-pm: we need an internal timeline and the customer blurb by EOD. Also, group to decide on whether to roll back autopromote feature entirely or add stricter validators.

sara: Handoff: I'm going to step out for the next hour. Leo, I'm passing the incident to you to drive the post-incident actions: complete the timeline, ensure PRs land, and validate the catalog scan. I'll remain available for customer comms. Handoff TS=2730001375.

leo: taking over. I'll collect logs, produce a detailed timeline, and coordinate with eng-runtime and eng-ml on the validation changes. Proposed actions assigned:
- leo: postmortem draft + timeline (due TOM EOD)
- mike: autopromote validator PR (add tokenizer check + integration test) (PR open in 2h)
- oliver: runtime guard + canary deploy (PR open now, canary tonight)
- tim: catalog full-scan + remediation tickets (start now)
- jane-support: customer blurb + affected list (ASAP)

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-2026-ACAT acknowledged by sara and escalated to eng-runtime, eng-catalog.

leo: summary for handoff message: immediate customer impact mitigated by pinning default and blacklisting the incompatible revision. Autopromote suspended. Next steps are validators and catalog hygiene. Will post final incident writeup to /incidents when complete.

jane-support: Acme confirmed fixes on their side; they requested a postmortem and timeline.

leo: ack. I'll keep updates in this thread as actions progress.
